title: REVA demographics component v1
description: Age and recorded sex of a weighted synthetic representative record of one age x recorded-sex population cell. Recorded sex is the sex recorded by the source statistical authority (Eurostat demo_pjan codes); it is not gender identity and is never re-coded. Unknown ages and open-ended top age groups are explicit categories; no age is imputed for them.

age.description: Age category as published by the source cell.

source_code.description: Source age code, e.g. Y_LT1, Y42, Y_OPEN, UNK.

years.description: Completed years of age; single_year only.

lower_bound_years.description: Inclusive lower bound; band and open_ended only.

recorded_sex.description: Sex as recorded by the source. Not gender identity.

code.description: F and M as published; UNK = not recorded/unknown, never imputed.

weight.description: Number of persons represented by this record (survey-style weight).

reference_date.description: 1 January reference date of the source cell.
